```sh
kafka token renew
```

Renew a delegation token, extending its expiry

Shared options and defaults: [connection profiles, JSON output, logging and help](../../../global-options/).

## Defaults

An omitted extension period is delegated to the broker/client default; the maximum lifetime still bounds renewal.

## Before you run

Extends bearer-token validity up to its maximum lifetime. Confirm the token identity and credential handling before renewal.

## Flags

| Flag                              | Description                                                     |
| --------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--brokers <string>`              | comma-separated broker list, e.g. localhost:9092                |
| `--hmac <string>`                 | the token's hmac, base64 (mutually exclusive with --hmac-stdin) |
| `--hmac-stdin`                    | read the token's hmac (base64) from stdin                       |
| `--renew-time-period-ms <string>` | how long to extend the expiry by, in ms                         |

## Examples

```sh
kafka token renew --hmac-stdin --renew-time-period-ms 86400000 --brokers localhost:9092
```

## Output

Illustrative, abbreviated output. Empty arrays show the result envelope; actual entries, identifiers, optional fields and broker errors depend on the request and cluster.

With `--json`:

```json
{
  "expiryTimestamp": "1700000000000"
}
```

Declared exit codes: `0`, `1`, `2`. See the exit-code reference for meanings.
